description: Remove tenant metadata, local-ydb containers, network, and storage for a profile, with optional host-path cleanup.

configPath.description: Absolute path to an explicit local-ydb config file. Missing, unreadable, oversized, or invalid explicit files fail closed instead of using defaults.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute planned commands. Omit or false for plan-only output.

profile.description: Named profile from local-ydb.config.json. Defaults to config.defaultProfile.

removeAuthArtifacts.description: Delete explicit authConfigPath, dynamicNodeAuthTokenFile, and rootPasswordFile when configured. Defaults to false.

removeBindMountPath.description: Delete profile.bindMountPath when the profile uses a bind mount. Defaults to false.

removeDumpHostPath.description: Delete profile.dumpHostPath. Defaults to false because it may be shared.

name: local_ydb_destroy_stack
